interpretations: a malformed reset request (approvers not a tuple of two non-empty strings, requester not a string) or an approver the registry cannot return is RESET_REQUIRES_DUAL_CONTROL, the reason code the reset already declares for an unresolved approver

a break-glass request of the wrong shape is BREAK_GLASS_GRANT_INVALID, audited as BREAK_GLASS_GRANT_DENIED, the reason code the controller already declares for a missing field; a grant that cannot be built stays the audited ValueError of the existing TTL bound

a break-glass use whose capability is not a non-empty string is BREAK_GLASS_CAPABILITY_NOT_GRANTED and whose review reference is not a non-empty string is BREAK_GLASS_REVIEW_REQUIRED; something other than a grant is BREAK_GLASS_GRANT_NOT_ISSUED
the qualifiers of a PolicyDecision are a tuple (its declared type): a string, a list or a set is POLICY_DECISION_INVALID
the reader caches a verified stop epoch under the key the keyring returns at each read, so a keyring that stops returning a key stops verifying the records it signed
a break-glass requester that is not a string is BREAK_GLASS_GRANT_INVALID like the other text fields of the request (audited), never a registry read

a registry that cannot be read, or returns something other than an IdentityRecord whose attributes are a mapping, is BREAK_GLASS_PRINCIPAL_ATTRIBUTES_INVALID, the reason code the controller already declares for malformed principal attributes; for the stop activation it is STOP_ACTIVATOR_UNAUTHORIZED, the activation's existing refusal
an empty recovery evidence stays the absence of a recovery (records before a reset); any other value that is not text is malformed
